root_idea.summary: The root centers on preserving, maintaining, and keeping something present in mind or practice. From this arise the meanings of a binding undertaking, an instruction entrusted for observance, repeated attention, and renewed acquaintance.
root_idea.development: The semantic field develops from preservation and continued attention to covenants and obligations, acquaintance with what has been encountered before, places or times associated with prior knowledge, and rain returning to land after earlier rain.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I citation form عَهِدَ.
Displayed under the normalized Form III citation form عَاهَدَ.
Displayed as the ordinary nominal citation form عَهْدٌ.

senses.definition: To enjoin, charge, or entrust someone with an instruction or duty.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially in the construction عَهِدَ إِلَى, with the matter entrusted for observance or performance.

senses.definition: To make, undertake, or keep a binding promise or commitment.
senses.usage_conditions: A commitment may be made to a person or concerning a matter; this is distinct from the directive construction عَهِدَ إِلَى.

senses.definition: To enter into a covenant, compact, treaty, or other mutual undertaking with someone.
senses.usage_conditions: The Form III construction presents the undertaking as reciprocal or between parties; the object may be a person or a community, and the commitment may be religious, social, or political.

senses.definition: A covenant, compact, pledge, promise, or binding undertaking.
senses.usage_conditions: The undertaking may be between people or between God and people; it is something placed under an obligation to preserve and observe.

senses.definition: The keeping or fulfilment of a promise, covenant, or comparable obligation.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense emphasizes faithful observance of what has been undertaken rather than the undertaking itself.

senses.definition: A covenant with God consisting in affirmation of His unity.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic religious interpretation of عهد in the expression concerning one who takes a covenant with the Compassionate; it is a specific content of the covenant, not a general synonym for monotheism.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To impose a condition or stipulate terms; also, to write a statement of a compact or covenant as binding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical construction concerning conditions or a written compact, not separately identified as a Quranic Form I usage in the supplied evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be mindful, regardful, or observant of what is sacred or inviolable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with something entitled to reverence, respect, honour, or defence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To meet or encounter someone or something in a particular place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a person or thing, commonly with a specification of place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To know, recognize, or be acquainted with someone or something in a given state or place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the passive sense of being known and expressions referring to what one previously knew or encountered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, a meadow, or a place, to be rained upon by عهد rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or intransitive weather use referring to the first or subsequent rain of the relevant kind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mutual compact, contract, covenant, agreement, confederacy, league, treaty, or engagement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun describing the joining of parties in a reciprocal undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To swear to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional extension of covenant-making in which the undertaking is expressed as an oath.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold someone clear of responsibility for an occurrence, or to make someone secure from it; by extension, to undertake responsibility for that person’s security.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction أَعْهَدُكَ مِنْ, including release from liability or assurance of protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To renew acquaintance with something, seek knowledge of it repeatedly, and attend to or restore it carefully.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe repeated return, inspection, care, reform, or putting a person or thing into proper condition; it can also mean frequent attention without a separate repair implication.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To unite with one another in a compact, contract, covenant, agreement, league, treaty, or engagement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal plural construction, synonymous in the supplied evidence with joining a contract or alliance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone responsible for accidents or consequences arising from himself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative-request construction assigning responsibility for possible harm or liability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An injunction, charge, bidding, order, or command.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use of عهد as the instruction or obligation that is to be observed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Protection, safeguard, assurance of security, responsibility, or suretyship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote a protective guarantee or the security owed under an established compact; ذُو عَهْدٍ refers to a person under such protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An oath, especially one securing the parties to a compact or covenant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often used in an oath formula in which the undertaking is invoked by God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A writ or diploma appointing someone to an office such as a governorship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A written instrument of appointment; this is distinct from the covenant or obligation recorded in it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Defence and attentive observance of persons or things regarded as sacred, inviolable, or worthy of honour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes mindfulness of what should be protected and observance of love or affection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A time or period, especially the time of a particular person, condition, or stage of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions such as “in the time of” someone or “during my youth.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A recent meeting, sighting, knowledge, or acquaintance with someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions such as عَهْدِي بِهِ, it can refer to the last known state, place, or encounter and to the recency of that acquaintance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first rain, or rain falling after earlier rain while the earlier moisture remains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related plural عِهَادٌ may denote such rains or the portions of land on which they have fallen; usage varies in its designation of the rainy season and type of rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A year of scant rainfall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression based on the rain sense of عهد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who makes a compact and with whom a compact is made; a confederate or treaty partner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word presents the relationship as mutual between the parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Old or ancient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of an old town, village, or comparable place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place not reached by the sun, associated in a rare cited usage with a depository of a secret.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The spelling and interpretation are reported as an unusual, verse-based usage and are not generalized to the ordinary warranty sense of عُهْدَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A written statement recording a purchase or sale, or a confederacy, league, compact, or covenant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The document is something to which one returns when doubt or uncertainty arises.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A return, claim for indemnification, warranty, or responsibility for a defect in something sold or entrusted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In commercial usage it concerns the purchaser’s right to return a faulty article or the seller’s continuing liability for its defect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A defect, weakness, or unfinished matter requiring return and rectification.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe an imperfection in an affair, an intellectual weakness, or faulty formation in handwriting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Parts of land upon which the relevant seasonal rain has fallen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural rain term connected with rain following or associated with the وَسْمِيّ season.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person bound by a treaty or covenant and thereby living under a protection agreement; by extension, a peaceful non-Muslim party under a defined truce or compact.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In legal and traditional usage it commonly denotes a member of أهل العهد or أهل الذمة, and can also apply to another unbelieving party with whom peace has been made for a specified time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where one used to know or meet someone or something, or a former abode to which people return.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a remembered place associated with love, familiarity, or recurrent return.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Known or previously familiar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective may be applied to what is known from prior experience or acquaintance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rained upon by the rain called عهد or عهدة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a place, land, or meadow; this is the passive adjectival weather use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land upon which a partial rain has fallen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived adjectival description of land reached by part of a rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be responsible, answerable, accountable, or a surety or guarantor for something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction عَهِدَ إِلَيَّ فُلَانٌ فِي كَذَا for assuming responsibility or guaranteeing someone with respect to a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who repeatedly applies himself to affairs, offices, or their reform.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe one who repeatedly attends to affairs and governments or who is devoted to offices and their appointment writs.
